database.pollingEstimate: Source-traced 2026-11-05: each successful PrismaRoomStore.getRoom call performs one Prisma Client participant.findFirst with relationLoadStrategy=join. Prisma counts each Prisma Client query as one operation regardless of internal SQL count. The last recorded Production Vercel environment value was VITE_ROOM_POLL_INTERVAL_MS=30000 (checked 2026-11-05 18:49 UTC); at that setting the estimate is 172,800 room-poll operations/month for two continuously open tabs and 345,600 for four. A two-hour guest match uses about 480 room-poll operations for two players or 960 for four, before setup/actions/reconnects. The source fallback when the variable is absent is 5,000 ms, which would yield 1,036,800 polls/month for two continuously open tabs. This fallback is not evidence of the deployed interval. Each visible signed-in account with presence opted in sends one heartbeat every 30 seconds; each calls one updateMany, adding about 120 operations per opted-in account per two-hour session.

Project totals: Preview 25,345; Production 12,452; reference 14,040; World Cup 89. They sum to the shared workspace meter. Production Backups page showed no backups and states automated daily backups are available on paid plans. One manual dump/restore drill passed once; no recurring schedule or named owner exists. Usage does not attribute operations to individual requests and synthetic activity may skew the daily average. No billing or database setting was changed.
database.workspacePollingHeadroomAtObservation: At the 2026-11-06 17:39 UTC direct Prisma Console meter, 148,074 shared operations remained. Source-based estimates at the last actually observed deployed polling interval of 30 seconds are about 480 room-poll operations for a two-player two-hour match and 960 for four players; if every remaining operation were used only for polls, this would be at most about 308 two-player or 154 four-player sessions, before setup, actions, reconnects, presence, other workspace projects, or system operations. Two tabs polling continuously every 30 seconds would produce an estimated 172,800 polls per 30-day month. The current Production poll value is not known from environment-variable names alone; the source fallback is five seconds if the variable is absent, which would produce an estimated 1,036,800 polls/month for two continuously open tabs. Neither estimate is measured gameplay capacity or a normal-use projection.
